scope: Provisional research PRIORITIZATION, not a statement of OS/400 V2R3 availability or binary field decoding.

weight_notes.project_value: Expert curation against read-only archiving, disk browsing, reconstructing original 5250 interaction. Unsurveyed code defaults to 2/5; values are hypotheses not IBM facts.
weight_notes.shared_unlock: Curated shared-structure value plus independently documented incoming relationships in mi_object_reviews. This is an estimation of potential leverage, NOT validated on-disk pointers.
weight_notes.evidence: Existing audited work, verified historical page refs, unverified lexical source hits, and physical candidate presence; lexical hits by themselves do NOT prove a field.
weight_notes.feasibility: Conservative prospective estimate from decoder maturity, evidence, sensitivity, and perceived CISC complexity. This is not elapsed-time cost.
weight_notes.image_coverage: Diminishing returns for physically observed first-page signatures on two archived disks. Does NOT count live/current objects or prove absence.

notes: Domains overlap; first matching domain in this ordered dictionary wins in the tabular overview; overlap is not a claimed pointer relationship.
Rankings are for next RESEARCH milestones, not generic decode completion and not a promise to implement without further evidence.
IBM's later catalog has entries absent from two CISC images; such entries are retained with not_observed_using_signature and may still deserve review.
